# sql.js runtime

Pinned upstream package: sql.js 1.13.0 from the npm registry.
Upstream: https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/sql.js/v/1.13.0

The production `sql-wasm.js` and `sql-wasm.wasm` files are unmodified. The upstream MIT licence is retained in LICENSE. This is SQLite compiled to WebAssembly, not a native SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL service. StudyLab wraps the runtime in a disposable Web Worker and documents the supported compatibility subset.
